Author: Santiago Pérez
Name: Gentle-Emotex
Description: Show Gentle-Emotex pixel-art frames on a Ulanzi D200 key.
Detail: Pure receive-and-display companion for the Gentle-Emotex emitter: the key mirrors the emitter's newest avatar frame on a D200 key, scaled from 64x64 to the key pixel grid. Gentle-Emotex is a fork of Gentle-Emote; this plugin is its D200 receiver. Pressing a key redraws its frame and requests focus for the displayed session when the emitter supports it.
